title: Crystallographic restriction and aperiodic substitution in SFT
description:
Exactly five periodic rotation orders, seven crystal systems and fourteen Bravais classes, with unrestricted native proofs and complete classification tables.

Maria Smith derives the crystallographic order restriction for every positive whole order, complete metric and centering quotients, coherent reciprocal support at every generated depth, exact substitution populations and exclusion of every positive rational fixed scale. Includes full mathematical arguments, 902 distinct empty-axiom audited definitions and theorems, pinned V3/V4 source correspondence, retained verification records and portable reproduction.

Correspondence: Maria.smith.sftoe@gmail.com. Join the SFT community: Discord invitation.
